entries.name: link-building (Marketing Skills)
entries.summary: Step-by-step link building playbook: confirm links are the bottleneck, pick tactics, prospect, qualify, outreach, anchors and pace, measure SEO and AI-citation outcomes.
entries.use_when: Planning an overall backlink campaign for a directory site and choosing which tactics to run first.
entries.author: Corey Haines (coreyhaines31)
entries.notes: Part of a 57k-star marketing skills repo. Points to sibling skills for PR and directory submissions. Written for SaaS, needs golf-specific context. Partial overlap with run-seo-from-claude-code-with-two-api-keys (link target list).

entries.name: public-relations (Marketing Skills)
entries.summary: Earned-media skill covering journalist pitching, HARO/Qwoted/Featured replies, newsjacking, press pages and measuring coverage and links.
entries.use_when: Answering journalist source requests or pitching golf stories/data to press for editorial links.
entries.author: Corey Haines (coreyhaines31)
entries.notes: Same repo as link-building-coreyhaines. Product/SaaS slant; works as a general PR method.

entries.name: LVTD SEO link-building plugin (13 skills)
entries.summary: Bundle of 13 link-building skills based on the Ultimate Guide to Link Building: strategy, prospecting, prospect qualification, outreach, guest posts, broken links, reclamation, linkable assets, scaled outreach ops.
entries.use_when: You want a full, white-hat link-building toolkit for Codex/Claude Code style agents in one install.
entries.author: LVTD-LLC
entries.notes: Very new repo (1 star), derived from Garrett French & Eric Ward's book. Also mirrored in hashgraph-online/awesome-codex-plugins. Individual skills for directories and local sponsorship catalogued separately.

entries.name: directory-link-evaluation
entries.summary: Judges directories, listings, citation sites, associations and resource indexes for real link value, spam risk, local relevance and submission fit.
entries.use_when: Deciding which golf, travel or local directories are worth submitting to, or auditing existing directory links.
entries.author: LVTD-LLC
entries.notes: Part of lvtd-seo-link-plugin. Complements agentize-saas-directory-launch-submissions (which runs submissions; this one filters targets).

entries.name: local-sponsorship-link-building
entries.summary: Plans and measures local sponsorship campaigns (events, nonprofits, clubs, local publishers) that earn visibility and legitimate links.
entries.use_when: Finding golf days, charity tournaments, junior programs or club events to sponsor for local links.
entries.author: LVTD-LLC
entries.notes: Part of lvtd-seo-link-plugin. Good fit for golf: tournaments and club events commonly list sponsors with links.

entries.name: apify-link-prospecting-outreach
entries.summary: Finds sites ranking for target keywords, scores them with Ahrefs, picks a pitch angle per prospect, drafts outreach emails and suggests exact link placements, output as a spreadsheet.
entries.use_when: Building a scored outreach list for a specific golf keyword or page you want linked.
entries.author: Daniela Ryplová (Apify)
entries.notes: Needs an APIFY_TOKEN, Ahrefs MCP, Node 20.6+ and npm install of bundled scripts (not run). Ahrefs plugin is already in the installed plugin cache. Overlaps run-tiered-outbound-across-cold-email-linkedin-d on cold email only loosely.

entries.name: seo-backlink-gap (SE Ranking)
entries.summary: Finds domains linking to several competitors but not to you, enriches with authority and anchors, and suggests an outreach angle per domain.
entries.use_when: Comparing your golf directory against competing directories to find the links they have and you do not.
entries.author: SE Ranking
entries.notes: Requires the SE Ranking MCP server (paid account). Vendor-maintained.

entries.name: backlink-audit (Semrush skills)
entries.summary: Official Semrush skill that audits a backlink profile, flags patterns for human review, finds competitor referring-domain gaps and lost-link recovery targets.
entries.use_when: Running a careful backlink audit and competitor gap check through Semrush MCP.
entries.author: Semrush
entries.notes: Needs Semrush MCP (see semrush-mcp). Explicitly warns against calling links toxic or disavowing from one metric. Same playbook appears on semrush.com/mcp/prompt-library/skills/backlink-audit.

entries.name: Semrush MCP server
entries.summary: Official hosted MCP server giving agents Semrush SEO, backlink, competitor and traffic reports; also exposes read-only project data.
entries.use_when: You have a Semrush plan and want backlink and competitor data inside an agent chat.
entries.author: Semrush
entries.notes: Paid service; uses API units. OAuth or API key. Endpoint https://mcp.semrush.com/v2/mcp. Not installed here.

entries.name: Ahrefs MCP server
entries.summary: Official remote MCP for Ahrefs: backlink profiles, referring domains, anchors, keywords, rank tracking, site audit and batch analysis.
entries.use_when: Competitor backlink analysis and link monitoring with Ahrefs data from an agent.
entries.author: Ahrefs
entries.notes: ALREADY PRESENT: Cursor 'ahrefs' plugin wrapper (MIT) is in the installed plugin cache but not connected as a live tool namespace. Needs paid Lite+ plan; API units shared with Ahrefs API. Terms forbid using the MCP endpoint from custom scripts.

entries.name: Moz MCP servers (Data and Local)
entries.summary: Two official hosted MCP endpoints: Moz Data (site metrics, links, link intersect, keywords) and Moz Local (manage and report on business listings).
entries.use_when: Checking domain authority/link intersect, or managing local listings, through Moz from an agent.
entries.author: Moz
entries.notes: Beta; paid API subscription for Data, Moz Local subscription for Local. Moz Local mainly suits businesses with addresses (e.g. golf courses), less so a pure online directory.

entries.name: DataForSEO MCP server
entries.summary: Official MCP server and CLI that lets agents read DataForSEO docs and call its APIs, including backlinks summary, referring domains and SERP data.
entries.use_when: Pay-per-call backlink, SERP and competitor data without a monthly SEO suite.
entries.author: DataForSEO
entries.notes: v3 server (v2 deprecated). Pay-as-you-go API account needed. Overlaps owned skill run-seo-from-claude-code-with-two-api-keys, which already uses a DataForSEO key.

entries.name: Hunter MCP server
entries.summary: Official hosted MCP for Hunter: domain search, email finder and verifier, enrichment, lead lists and email sequences.
entries.use_when: Finding and verifying the right contact email for link prospects, then running outreach sequences.
entries.author: Hunter
entries.notes: MCP itself free; usage spends Hunter credits. Sequence tools can send real email, so keep human approval on. Overlaps run-tiered-outbound-across-cold-email-linkedin-d (cold email channel).

entries.name: local-citations (Local SEO Skills)
entries.summary: Citation strategy skill: NAP consistency rules, tiered citation build list (aggregators, major, industry, local/niche), audit and cleanup steps.
entries.use_when: Building or cleaning up citations for golf courses or listed businesses, or planning niche directory listings.
entries.author: Garrett Smith
entries.notes: Defaults to the paid LocalSEOData tool for audits; suggests Whitespark or BrightLocal for submissions. Most useful if Steven's sites list physical courses or he advises them.

entries.name: seo-directory-backlinks (directory and backlink register)
entries.summary: Register template for tracking directory and backlink placements: platform, target URL, follow attribute, authority/spam scores, approval and NAP-match status, as CSV/SQL/Notion.
entries.use_when: Keeping one tracker of every directory submission and backlink across several golf sites.
entries.author: WHOISABHISHEKADHIKARI (catalogued by sickn33)
entries.notes: Catalogue copy says a referenced master directory list is missing and must come from the upstream repo. Pairs with agentize-saas-directory-launch-submissions (which tracks submission state).

entries.name: HARO / Qwoted / Featured / Source of Sources SME quotes
entries.summary: Daily routine for answering journalist source requests across Featured, Qwoted, Source of Sources and #JournoRequest, with triage, timing and a tracking table.
entries.use_when: Running HARO-style expert-quote replies to earn editorial links for golf topics.
entries.author: CraftOS-dev
entries.notes: Small repo (9 stars). Assumes Notion and X MCP tools. Platform claims (e.g. Featured as revived HARO) are the author's; check before relying on them.

entries.name: Link building outreach (Pitchbox / Respona / BuzzStream)
entries.summary: Recipes for broken-link, competitor-broken-link, unlinked-mention and resource-page prospecting, outreach tool setup, reply parsing and post-outreach link verification.
entries.use_when: Choosing and wiring an outreach tool, or running broken-link and resource-page campaigns.
entries.author: CraftOS-dev
entries.notes: Paid outreach tools ($24-$499+/mo per the skill). Includes a link verification step useful for tracking. Overlaps run-tiered-outbound-across-cold-email-linkedin-d on email outreach.

entries.name: crawlgraph-mcp
entries.summary: MCP server with five backlink tools on Common Crawl data: backlinks, backlink changes, gap analysis, gap outreach targets and release info.
entries.use_when: Cheap backlink lookups, competitor gap lists and tracking new/lost links between crawl releases.
entries.author: pucilpet (CrawlGraph)
entries.notes: Small project (8 stars); README says directory verification is pending. Needs a CrawlGraph API key (free key flow). Common Crawl data is coarser and less fresh than Ahrefs/Semrush.

entries.name: claude-seo (seo-backlinks and seo local)
entries.summary: Large SEO skill suite; its seo-backlinks sub-skill analyses profiles, anchors, gaps and disavow candidates using free sources (Common Crawl, Moz, Bing Webmaster) with optional DataForSEO.
entries.use_when: Backlink and local SEO analysis on a budget, without a paid backlink database.
entries.author: AgriciDaniel
entries.notes: 25k stars. Bundles helper scripts (not run). Overlaps run-seo-from-claude-code-with-two-api-keys (DataForSEO) and pull-leads-from-seo-aeo-via-gsc-striking-distanc (GSC side).

entries.name: Link Building Outreach Agent
entries.summary: Six-step agent workflow: find niche sites, qualify guest-post/resource opportunities, find real contacts, draft outreach, track replies, draft follow-ups; never sends on its own.
entries.use_when: Running a no-paid-API guest post and resource page outreach pipeline for a golf niche.
entries.author: robort-gabriel
entries.notes: Built for Zo Computer with Claude; 0 stars, created Jul 2026. No licence file, so reuse terms are unclear. Overlaps run-tiered-outbound-across-cold-email-linkedin-d.

entries.name: programmatic-seo (Marketing Skills)
entries.summary: Guides building SEO pages at scale from templates and data (directory, location and comparison pages) while avoiding thin-content penalties.
entries.use_when: Planning course, suburb or event pages across Sydney Golf Guide and Australia Golf Guide.
entries.author: Corey Haines (coreyhaines31)
entries.notes: Explicitly covers 'directory pages' and '[keyword] + [city] pages'. Same repo as link-building-coreyhaines.

entries.name: structured-data-jsonld
entries.summary: Detailed JSON-LD guide with recipes for LocalBusiness, Event, Organization, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, VideoObject and more, plus @graph linking, framework integration and validation.
entries.use_when: Adding Event and golf course (LocalBusiness/SportsActivityLocation) markup to the directory sites.
entries.author: messeb
entries.notes: Thorough content but brand-new repo with 0 stars. Search also surfaced a 'structured-data-optimizer' inside a malware-skill benchmark dataset (lxyeternal/MalSkillBench); not catalogued, avoid.

entries.name: Local SEO Skills (39 skills)
entries.summary: Local SEO skill pack: GBP optimisation, audits, citations, reviews, geogrid, multi-location SEO, client deliverables, plus tool skills for Local SEO Data, Local Falcon, BrightLocal, Semrush, Ahrefs and scheduled monitoring task templates.
entries.use_when: Doing local SEO for golf clubs as Golf Campaign Co clients, or for course listings.
entries.author: Garrett Smith
entries.notes: Parent of local-citations-localseoskills. Tool skills default to paid Local SEO Data credits. README offers a curl|bash install script (not run; review before any install).

entries.name: Local Falcon MCP server
entries.summary: MCP server for Local Falcon: geo-grid local rank scans, Google Business Profile data, competitor reports and AI visibility tracking.
entries.use_when: Showing a golf club client how it ranks in Maps across Sydney suburbs.
entries.author: Local Falcon
entries.notes: Server code is MIT; needs a paid Local Falcon account. Better fit for club clients than for the directories themselves.

entries.name: cold-email (Marketing Skills)
entries.summary: B2B cold outbound skill: writing first emails and follow-ups, sending setup and deliverability, LinkedIn and multichannel cadences, reply handling.
entries.use_when: Writing outreach to golf club GMs and marketing managers for Golf Campaign Co.
entries.author: Corey Haines (coreyhaines31)
entries.notes: Overlaps owned run-tiered-outbound-across-cold-email-linkedin-d (channel plan); this one is stronger on copy and deliverability.

entries.name: Apify MCP server
entries.summary: Official Apify MCP: lets agents search and run thousands of ready-made scrapers (Google Maps, websites, SERPs, social) and read structured results.
entries.use_when: Scraping golf event listings and club data, or building club prospect lists from Google Maps.
entries.author: Apify
entries.notes: Hosted at mcp.apify.com (OAuth) or local stdio. Actors are paid per use. Overlaps owned build-a-local-business-lead-list-from-google-map. Check each source site's terms before scraping.

entries.name: Postiz
entries.summary: Open-source social media scheduler (self-host or cloud) with an MCP endpoint and agent CLI; posts to Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook and many more.
entries.use_when: Running one publishing queue for all three brands' social accounts.
entries.author: gitroomhq (Postiz)
entries.notes: 40k stars. Self-hosting means creating your own Meta/TikTok developer apps and approvals (can take weeks); cloud plan has pre-approved apps.

entries.name: TryPost
entries.summary: Open-source scheduler built for AI agents: MCP server with 80+ tools for posts, media, queues, approvals and analytics, plus a team composer and calendar.
entries.use_when: Letting an agent draft a week of posts into per-channel queues for human approval.
entries.author: trypostit
entries.notes: 795 stars; supports Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, Google Business. Cloud or self-host.

entries.name: pendpost
entries.summary: Local-first social planner where an agent drafts and schedules posts and every post passes a human approval gate; covers Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and blogs.
entries.use_when: You want agent-drafted social posts that cannot go live without approval.
entries.author: Nomadik GmbH
entries.notes: Small (17 stars), MIT. README lists TikTok among later/extra networks; confirm current support.

entries.name: social (Marketing Skills)
entries.summary: Social content skill: platform-specific posts for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, content calendars, scheduling and engagement triage.
entries.use_when: Planning what each brand posts each week and adapting one asset per platform.
entries.author: Corey Haines (coreyhaines31)
entries.notes: Content method only; pair with a scheduler (postiz, trypost or pendpost).

entries.name: bulkpublish-social-scheduling
entries.summary: Skill for scheduling and publishing across 15 networks through the BulkPublish hosted MCP or REST API, with per-platform rules checked up front.
entries.use_when: You prefer a hosted multi-network publisher over self-hosting.
entries.author: davepoon (buildwithclaude collection)
entries.notes: Tied to the commercial BulkPublish service; skill text is MIT.

entries.name: mcp-builder
entries.summary: Guide to designing and building good MCP servers in Python (FastMCP) or TypeScript: tool design, implementation, testing and writing evaluations.
entries.use_when: Improving the Australia Golf Guide public events MCP service.
entries.author: Anthropic
entries.notes: Widely copied into other skill collections; this is the original. Related owned skill: expose-a-site-as-webmcp-tools (browser-side tools, different approach).

entries.name: FastMCP
entries.summary: Python framework for building MCP servers and clients quickly, with auth, deployment and testing support.
entries.use_when: Building or rebuilding the events MCP service in Python.
entries.author: PrefectHQ
entries.notes: Framework, not an agent add-on; type set to plugin for lack of a better fit.

entries.name: MCP Inspector
entries.summary: Official developer tool for testing and debugging MCP servers: list tools, call them, inspect responses.
entries.use_when: Checking the events MCP service behaves correctly before and after changes.
entries.author: Model Context Protocol project
entries.notes: Dev tool; runs locally via npx (not run here).

entries.name: MCP Registry
entries.summary: Official public registry of MCP servers that clients use for discovery, with a publish flow for server owners.
entries.use_when: Listing the Australia Golf Guide events MCP so AI clients can find it.
entries.author: Model Context Protocol project
entries.notes: README says preview status with an API freeze at v0.1; check current state before publishing. Doubles as a discoverability/link channel for the directory.

entries.name: Firecrawl MCP server
entries.summary: MCP server for Firecrawl: search, scrape and crawl live web pages into clean Markdown or structured JSON.
entries.use_when: Pulling event details from club and association websites into structured records.
entries.author: Firecrawl (mendableai)
entries.notes: Needs a Firecrawl API key (paid tiers) or self-hosted Firecrawl. Respect robots and site terms.

entries.name: Crawl4AI
entries.summary: Open-source crawler that turns sites into LLM-ready Markdown or JSON; self-host free or use the hosted API.
entries.use_when: A free, self-hosted way to scrape event pages on a schedule.
entries.author: unclecode
entries.notes: 87k stars. Library/service rather than an agent add-on; type set to plugin.

entries.name: Atrium
entries.summary: Self-hosted, branded client portal for agencies: projects and updates, file and link deliverables, documents for approval, invoicing.
entries.use_when: Giving golf club clients one place for briefs, progress updates and delivered video/photo files.
entries.author: Vibra Labs (@edgarjc)
entries.notes: Self-hosted app, not an agent add-on; type 'template' used as closest fit. No frame-accurate video review; approvals are document-level. 83 stars.

entries.name: short-form-ffmpeg-cookbook
entries.summary: Tested FFmpeg commands for turning footage into 9:16 Reels/TikTok/Shorts: crop, trim, join, burn captions, duck music under voice.
entries.use_when: Fast, free vertical cuts of course-visit footage for clubs.
entries.author: vargHQ
entries.notes: Local and free with ffmpeg. Complements owned auto-edit-talking-head-videos-with-claude-code-a and ship-30-identical-shorts. Descript is already connected for transcript-based edits.

entries.name: Remotion Agent Skills
entries.summary: Official Remotion skills for creating and editing programmatic React videos: compositions, animation, captions, media and rendering.
entries.use_when: Templated branded video (event promos, course cards) generated from data.
entries.author: Remotion
entries.notes: No licence file in the skills repo; Remotion itself needs a paid company licence for larger businesses. Overlaps owned build-motion-graphics-videos-with-claude-code.

entries.name: Herk Edit Kit
entries.summary: Video-editing kit for Codex and Claude Code built on HyperFrames: cut dead air, review mistakes, plan story, captions, B-roll and motion graphics, including short-form edits.
entries.use_when: Agent-edited short-form reels from raw club footage end to end.
entries.author: Nate Herk
entries.notes: 2.5k stars. Heavy overlap with owned auto-edit-talking-head-videos-with-claude-code-a (same HyperFrames approach); compare before adopting.

entries.name: still-image-retouching-finishing
entries.summary: Tool-agnostic photo post-production skill: RAW development, exposure, white balance, colour, masking, honest retouching, sharpening, export variants and metadata.
entries.use_when: Setting a consistent edit and export standard for course and club photography.
entries.author: calesthio
entries.notes: Process guidance, not an editor. Canva is already connected for layouts and resizing.
